title: Quote in an hour
caption: A contractor wants prices before he orders. Tarun sends a clean quote the same hour. Lumi tells his story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, My items and prices keeps the last selling rate and cost of everything the owner sells. A quotation is built from it, shared as a PDF, and turned into a recorded sale in one tap when the customer says yes.

cast.tarun: Tarun, a middle-aged Indian building-materials dealer with a trimmed beard, in a grey shirt with rolled sleeves

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a building materials shop with stacked cement bags and paint tins behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Tarun's story. A contractor asks for prices before he orders, and wants them the same hour.
